rejectedCandidates.rejectionReason: Single forum post using an informal initialism for the HydroConquest collection as a whole; not corroborated by any second independent source, and does not precisely correspond to any single complete watchId/reference configuration as required for localNicknames/collectionAliases acceptance. Too weak/ambiguous to accept as an established German-market nickname.

nicknameResearch.notes: Searched via WebSearch for German-language colloquial nicknames ('Spitzname') across the five most prominent Longines collections sold in the German market (Master Collection, Conquest/HydroConquest, La Grande Classique, Spirit Zulu Time). German watch-forum discussions (uhrforum.de, sinn-uhrenforum.de) consistently refer to Longines models by their full official collection/model name and reference number rather than by informal nicknames; the only informal shorthand found ('LHC') was a single-source, collection-level initialism that did not meet the exact-configuration-match/corroboration bar, so 0 candidates were accepted. All collectionAliases entries in data/markets/longines-germany-market.json were therefore left as empty names/sources arrays, matching the convention already used in the committed data/markets/longines-switzerland-market.json.
